name: Fundamentals
description: Core concepts every engineer must understand before designing systems — scalability, availability, and estimation.

lessons.title: Availability & Reliability
lessons.description: Understanding the nines of availability, failure modes, redundancy, and designing systems that stay online.

lessons.title: Back-of-the-Envelope Estimation

lessons.title: Scalability & Performance
lessons.description: Understanding vertical vs horizontal scaling, performance metrics, and designing systems that grow with demand.
